model: exact I=3/2 Hermitian Hamiltonian; axial effective Zeeman anisotropy coaxial with EFG
effective_kappa_definition: (nu_parallel - nu_perp)/nu_iso; absolute Knight shift is not calibrated
objective: unweighted SSE after separate per-series maximum normalization; descriptive, not chi-square
primary_RF: archive isotropic RF operator; anisotropic static Zeeman Hamiltonian
RF_sensitivity: full axial RF tensor at fixed nonlinear parameters; linear nuisance reoptimized
optimizer: bounded finite-difference damped Gauss-Newton; deterministic local multistart and one dense warm polish; no global guarantee
kappa_scan: clipped fixed-nonlinear feasible curve with linear nuisance refitted; not a profile minimum or confidence bound
identifiability: local variable-projection finite-difference Jacobian; inverse Gram correlations are geometric, not statistical confidence
forecasts: fixed spectroscopic parameters at other fields; no absolute Knight calibration, no extrapolated linear background, no relaxation prediction
